metadata.label: Cosmic Nebula
metadata.description: Adds a dim drifting magenta and teal gas nebula near the screen edges; bass brightens it gently.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image to add the nebula behind.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image with a faint nebula added.

controlDescriptions.bassGlow: How strongly bass brightens the nebula.
controlDescriptions.brightness: Overall nebula strength. It stays dim at every setting.
controlDescriptions.drift: How fast the gas clouds drift.
controlDescriptions.hue: Tint blended into the magenta and teal gas.
controlDescriptions.scale: Size of the cloud features. Higher values give smaller clouds.

metadata.label: Pulse Ripples
metadata.description: Expanding glowing rings around the bell that spawn on bass hits and gently refract the image.

controlDescriptions.distortion: How strongly rings refract the image.
controlDescriptions.sensitivity: How easily bass hits spawn a new ring.

metadata.label: Star Plankton
metadata.description: Adds drifting cyan and gold bioluminescent motes in parallax layers; highs make them sparkle.

controlDescriptions.density: How many grid cells hold a plankton mote.
controlDescriptions.drift: How fast the motes rise and drift.
controlDescriptions.sparkle: How strongly highs make motes flash brighter.
